description: Live status for one tracked provider: overall state, non-operational services, and open incidents, read from the vendor's official status feed. Accepts a slug, provider name, or product name (e.g., "claude" resolves to Anthropic). Use this first for any "is X down?" question. When regions are present, reportedCodes lists published codes; notOperational lists impaired rows. If those rows are truncated, notOperationalCodes lists every impaired code. For an inventory feed, a reported code absent from the complete impaired list is operational; an unreported code has no published status. Withdrawn readings omit these lists.

provider.description: Provider slug, name, or product name, e.g., "aws", "GitHub", "chatgpt".

name: get_provider_status
title: Get provider status
